name: dayrow
description: A Timeline day: the 58px column carries the date, the row the day's lede. An empty day is not a row.

date.description: The day, in a time element (Sun 9).

datetime.description: ISO date for the time element.

places.after: a mark after the day's lede: --s4 above

exposes.--aj-c-dayrow-date: The date column's colour (--rule-2). The Timeline's record sets it to the day's mood colour while the day is framed after a jump (v4 C1).
exposes.--aj-c-dayrow-date-fade: The date column's transition (none). The record sets it while the date takes the mood colour.

states.loading: n/a: a container shows its contents

changelog.change: Exposes the date column's colour and its transition (v4 C1, the jump arrival's held date).
Hook date on the date cell (v4 C1): the Timeline's search dates a later row of a day whose first row it hides. Markup only: one attribute.

hooks.date: the date cell (empty where the row continues the day): the Timeline's search writes the day's date into it (a time element) when the day's first row is hidden, and empties it again
